messages:
alex_sales: Heads up — Aurora Bank sent over the SIG (v2024) and asked for question-by-question evidence. I started a quick pass and flagged items we need to pull.
maya_security: I can take encryption + key management questions (Q12, Q13, Q22). Need KMS rotation policy, screenshot of key list, and a redacted key owner matrix.
tariq_se: I'll own network segmentation and perimeter controls (Q45, Q46, Q47). Will scrub and attach a sanitized network diagram + sample firewall rules.
olivia_customer: They specifically asked for SOC2 Type II report, proof of EU residency for customer data, and confirmation that we support customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key).
katie_pmo: Timeline from Aurora: they want a draft environment within 72 hours. Can we hit that if we split the work? :hourglass:
alex_sales: Proposal — deliver a partial SIG with full answers for low-effort ones (auth, logging, change control) and mark KMS/SOC2 pieces as "in progress" with ETA. I'll note any third-party attestation dependencies.
maya_security: Agreed. Quick checklist I'm collecting now:
```
- SOC2 Type II PDF (latest)
- KMS rotation policy doc (redacted)
- Key access matrix (redacted)
- Encryption-at-rest config snippet (example)
- KMS audit log screenshot
```
Uploading SOC2 to secure share in a sec: https://secure.redwood.example/s/aurora/soc2 (placeholder link)

maya_security: For Q12 (encryption in transit) — we use TLS1.2+ with cert rotation via our CA pipeline. I'll paste the short answer and attach cert-rotation runbook.
tariq_se: For Q45 (network isolation) — diagram upload: https://drive.redwood/diagrams/aurora-sanitized-network.png (will strip IPs). Example firewall snippet I plan to attach:
```
# allow management from bastion only
ufw allow from 10.0.10.0/24 to any port 22 proto tcp
# block all other ingress
ufw default deny incoming
```

olivia_customer: Also they're asking who has access to private keys — need the roles list plus MFA requirement screenshots.
maya_security: I'll export the roles list (sanitized), and a screenshot of our IAM MFA enforcement page. Expect those in ~90m.
katie_pmo: Tagging delivery plan for internal tracking: alex -> customer comms, maya -> security artifacts, tariq -> infra artifacts. I'll compile and run a quick QA pass before sending.
alex_sales: Perfect. Quick ask — can someone confirm whether we support HSM-backed keys (BYOK) or only KMS? I thought we support HSM for Dedicated & Private.
maya_security: We support HSM (via partner HSM or cloud HSM) for Dedicated/Private deployments, but Hosted customers use cloud KMS. I'll add a sentence distinguishing hosting tiers in the answer.
sig-bot: Reminder: SIG question mapping saved to /docs/sig-mapping/aurora-2422223333.xlsx
katie_pmo: Small blocker — legal asked for a redaction checklist before we share SOC2. Maya, can you follow our redaction template? I'll attach the template in 10m.
maya_security: On it. I'll use the standard template and post the redacted SOC2 to the secure share once done. ETA 2hrs for the full bundle.
alex_sales: I'll tell Aurora we're sending a partial SIG with completed sections now and outstanding items (SOC2 redaction, KMS attestation) due by Monday. :thumbsup:
olivia_customer: Thanks — please mark customer-managed keys as "supported for Dedicated/Private; onboarding assistance required".

alex_sales: Noted. I'll include that wording. Thanks all — I'll update this thread when I get confirmation from Aurora on accepting partial deliveries. :eyes:
